product_scope: Owned immersive shinobi game and functional coverage of all supplied reference mods

tasks.title: Inventory the supplied 49 reference JARs
acceptance: Every supplied JAR is represented with exact bytes and SHA-256; no third-party payload is published.

tasks.title: Establish behavioral ledger and first auditable feature slice
acceptance: Each observed mechanic has acquisition, input, effects, counterplay, persistence and presentation obligations.
Unknown behavior and intentional departures are explicit; no overall completion percentage is invented.
The ledger/schema and initial observed slice enable implementation; exhaustive observation of all 49 mods is not a prerequisite for independent work.
